description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableThing' representing a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constructors, getter, setter, removal, and JSON serialization methods for properties like ID, attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, policy, metadata, and ACL. It serves as a core data model class within the model/things package, supporting operations on 'Thing' instances.

classes.name: ImmutableThing
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the 'Thing' interface representing a device or entity within Eclipse Ditto. It encapsulates properties like ID, attributes, features, lifecycle status, revision, timestamps, policy, and metadata. Provides various methods to create modified copies with updated properties, and to serialize the object to JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create ImmutableThing instances with various initial parameters, with support for deprecated overloads.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the optional revision of the Thing.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns the optional timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns the optional creation timestamp.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the Thing is deleted based on its lifecycle status.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the entity ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the namespace string of the Thing ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the Attributes object.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableThing instance with the specified Attributes.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute by JsonPointer and JsonValue, returning a new updated instance.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attributes, returning a new instance.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute specified by JsonPointer.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the lifetime definition.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition identifier, using an immutable definition object.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the current definition, setting it to null.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the Features object.

methods.name: removeFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features, returning a new instance.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets the Features property.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or updates a specific feature by Feature object.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by its ID.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets a feature's definition by feature ID and definition object.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes a feature's definition by feature ID.

methods.name: setFeatureProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperties
methods.description: Removes properties from a feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property value for a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns an optional ACL object.

methods.name: setAccessControlList
methods.description: Sets the ACL, throws if incompatible with policy.

methods.name: setAclEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an ACL entry.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the associated Policy ID.

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the Policy ID.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the lifecycle state.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle state.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an optional containing metadata.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JsonObject based on schema version and predicate filter.
